# ESPACIO — Luxury Interior Design & Architecture Studio (Hyderabad, India)

> ESPACIO is Hyderabad's premier luxury turnkey interior design and architectural execution studio. Fusing 40+ years of structural legacy with bespoke interior architecture, high-precision modular joinery, and direct material sourcing.

## Turnkey Interior Architecture Services
- Full-Home Turnkey Interiors: End-to-end design, MEP planning, carpentry, civil modifications, and project handover.
- Bespoke Modular Kitchens: High-gloss acrylic, PU lacquered, quartz waterfall islands, and Blum hardware joinery.
- Architectural Ceilings & Lighting: Multi-tier cove lighting, 3000K warm architectural illumination, and gypsum drop coves.
- Custom Wardrobes & Walk-In Closets: Floor-to-ceiling glass vitrines, champagne gold profiles, and sensor LED strips.
- Direct Material Sourcing: In-house supply of WPC wall panels, digital Korean polygranite, charcoal louvers, and LVT luxury flooring.

## Featured Portfolio Projects
